Definition: 'To die for the son', probably the title of a popular song
BiblicalUsage: Muth is death, as a noun — for this God is our God for ever and ever, He will be our guide even unto death. The same word stands in a psalm heading, Muth-labben, the title of a song whose words are lost to us now.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the promise is the whole psalm in one line: the God who guides through life guides through death too, and the guiding does not stop at the grave.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
